inputs.text: {"scene":"A wide fantasy landscape of a city built across the tops of five enormous rock spires rising from a sea of low cloud. Four long winding suspension bridges connect the spires, sagging in gentle catenary curves and crossing at different heights to layer through the depth. More than forty tiny dark ink silhouettes populate the city and bridges, growing smaller and paler with distance. Three thin-necked birds glide through the empty air between the spires.","subjects":[{"description":"Five enormous rock spires crowned with a city of tiled roofs, narrow towers, laundry lines, and small round windows, all painted in warm sepia and pale ochre with dark ink outlines.","position":"Across the wide horizontal scene, rising from the cloud sea; the largest spire stands on the right, with the furthest spire receding into the distance.","action":"Rise above the clouds and support the city."},{"description":"Four long suspension bridges with fine ink-stroke cables and gently sagging catenary curves.","position":"Connecting the five spires at different heights, with the widest bridge crossing the centre middle-ground.","action":"Wind between the spires and carry small silhouettes moving in both directions."},{"description":"More than forty human figures, each only a small dark ink silhouette with no facial features or other detail. Roughly fifteen crowd the widest central bridge; about ten are scattered singly along the two higher bridges on the left; six lean over rooftop terrace railings on the largest right-hand spire; five sit along a low wall in the near foreground, seen from behind and looking across the cloud sea; the remaining figures are tiny specks on the furthest spire, reading as marks rather than bodies. The silhouettes become progressively smaller and paler with distance.","position":"Distributed across the central bridge, the two higher bridges on the left, the largest spire's rooftop terraces, a low foreground wall, and the furthest spire.","action":"Move in both directions along the widest bridge, stand singly along the higher bridges, lean over terrace railings, sit facing the cloud sea, and appear as distant specks."},{"description":"Three thin-necked birds rendered with spare ink marks and translucent wash.","position":"In the open air between the spires.","action":"Glide between the spires."},{"description":"A sea of low cloud rendered in broad wet-in-wet indigo washes, with soft blooms and hard-edged tide marks where pigment dried.","position":"Across the lower portion of the landscape, surrounding the bases of the spires.","action":"Fill the valley below the city."},{"description":"A faint circle of a low sun showing through a pale ochre wash that grades to nearly white at the horizon.","position":"Near the right edge of the sky, above the cloud sea.","action":"Glow faintly through the wash."}],"style":"Ink and watercolour painting on cold-pressed paper, with visible paper tooth, bleeding pigment edges, granulating washes, confident dark ink linework over soft colour, translucent pigment that lets the paper glow through, and visible brush edges, backruns, and dry-brush scumbling throughout. Nothing has a digital appearance.","color_palette":["indigo","sepia","pale ochre","thin sea green"],"lighting":"A graded pale ochre sky wash, nearly white at the horizon, with a faint low sun burning through near the right edge. Translucent washes allow the paper to glow through.","mood":"Vast, quiet, and dreamlike, with the small city and its inhabitants suspended above the cloud sea.","background":"The sky fills the upper portion with a graded pale ochre wash fading to nearly white at the horizon. Broad indigo cloud washes fill the lower distance around the spires, with soft blooms and dried, hard-edged tide marks.","composition":"Wide horizontal landscape composition. Show all five spires and the four winding bridges across the frame, layering the bridges at different heights. Place the widest bridge and its dense crowd in the centre middle-ground; the largest spire and faint sun sit toward the right. Recede the furthest spire into the distance, and place the five seated silhouettes along a low wall in the near foreground. Preserve open air between the spires for the three birds.","camera":{"angle":"Wide, slightly elevated landscape view across the spires and cloud sea.","lens":"Not applicable to a painted landscape.","depth_of_field":"Atmospheric depth conveyed through progressively smaller and paler distant silhouettes and spires."}}
